Tightened the `modal` dependency from an unfloored bare requirement to `>=1.4.3` -- matching the workspace-wide `modal==1.4.3` pin and the repo's other modal consumers, and deliberately below the harbor `[modal]` extra's conflicting `>=1.5.1` floor. This is dependency hygiene alongside the mngr-minds-eval migration off Modal's legacy Sandbox filesystem API (the `sandbox.filesystem` API it needs exists as of 1.4.0).
